disclosure.text: While this Mac is a member of the owner's swarm and this app is open, it will automatically: accept work the owner assigns to it; download and store only the model slice assigned to it; load that slice with MLX and compute it for requests routed through the swarm; and send the owner a capability report (chip, memory, free disk, MLX availability, power and thermal state) and a link measurement over the relay on join and before each run. Limits: at most the disk, memory, run time and command budget you choose below, only on the power and network policy you chose, and it stops on serious thermal pressure. Cooperative workers observe the activations they compute, so this is not confidential inference. You can withdraw this consent at any time from this app; automatic acceptance stops immediately.
